releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.20:
- 1-Click 6-Pack Bucket: Direct single-button option to immediately add a full 6-pack bucket of the selected beer to the order in 1 tap without extra prompts.
- Streamlined 6-Pack Only Standard: Removed 5-pack option across all bucket menus; standardized on 6-pack buckets ($30.00).
- Pre-filled Mix & Match: Mix modal immediately starts at 6/6 beers for the chosen brand, enabling 1-tap confirmation or custom beer swaps.
- Unified Barcode Scanner Engine: Seamlessly distinguishes between physical product barcodes and order/ticket numbers.
- Automated Integrity Inspection: Pre-flight quality verification passed with 0 errors.
